content_zh:
顾不得两人姿势暧昧，玉绯烟伸手勾着夏侯擎天的脖子，贪婪地吮吸着酸爽的浆汁。
“小野猫，你在引火上身——”被玉绯烟轻易撩起的火，让夏侯擎天黑色的眸子染上了紫金色，心里沉睡的猛兽被撩拨醒，在嘶吼，在咆哮。
虽然不知道为什么面对玉绯烟自己会轻易地失控，夏侯擎天还是在最短的时间里恢复了理智。
深吸了口气，平息了内心的燥热，他再次将果浆渡进玉绯烟口中，只等她神情清醒，才缓缓地放开了她的唇。
蓝星果的功效非常明显，凉凉的液体让玉绯烟通体舒畅，头脑也慢慢清醒过来，这才察觉到两人的姿态非常诡异。
夏侯擎天仅仅一块白布遮在腰腹间，她被他圈在怀里，后背紧贴着他结实的胸膛，来自男人的阳刚之气包裹着她，玉绯烟瞬间红了脸颊。
她算是……被间接吃豆腐？
“放开我！”
玉绯烟推了推夏侯擎天。
哪知道对方的胸膛完全就是铜墙铁壁，反倒是她全身的力气像被抽干了似的，软绵绵的，只能像藤蔓一样，依靠着他。
而她被滋润了的嗓子现在恢复了软糯的嗓音，这三个字从她嘴里说出来，竟然带着一股缠绵撒娇的意味，看到夏侯擎天戏谑的眼神，玉绯烟连忙捂着唇。
“真是个没良心的小东西！刚才是谁扒着爷来着？”
夏侯擎天捏着玉绯烟的下巴，目光肆意侵略着她不知道是因为害羞还是因为泉水而变得绯红的脸。
“你，你趁人之危……”
玉绯烟刚想借助手肘的力量脱离对方的怀抱，却发现对方脸上写着“欲求不满”四个字，吓得她一动不动。
哥，高抬贵手！
姐还小！
再说要吃肉，也不能选择这里，这也未免太狂野了——
“胆小鬼！”
见玉绯烟示弱，夏侯擎天轻嗤一声，声音依旧清华高贵，可说出来的话却邪恶无比。“爷对豆芽菜没兴趣，等你再长大点儿，爷说不定会赐给你一个主动献身的机会！”

说完，夏侯擎天邪恶地扫过她身上，玉绯烟连忙双手环抱，挡住对方火辣的目光。
玉绯烟完全被对方的自大击败。
谁要主动献身？谁要你赐给这样的机会！自大狂！
玉绯烟扭头，懒得理会夏侯擎天，却发现旁边是一汪银蓝色的泉水，水面上冒着阵阵寒气。
他刚才说这是烈火泉，难道那边的是寒冰泉？
玉绯烟瞬间有些呆滞。
据《药王圣经》记载，太极养生泉由烈火泉和寒冰泉组成。一冷一热，一阴一阳。两种极端的调和，不但能易筋洗髓，让人脱胎换骨，还能重塑肉体，将人身体调整到最佳状态。
不过，太极养生泉只有十天时效，超过时间就会变成普通的泉水，这也是它极其珍贵的原因。
因为它是习武者最可遇不可求的机缘，《药王圣经》将其誉为天下第一泉……
玉绯烟原本以为太极养生泉只是传说，没想到她竟亲眼见到。就在刚才，她已经察觉到自己纤细的筋络发生了变化，这些都是烈火泉带来的好处。
如果两种泉水搭配起来使用，她因身体原因不能习武的问题就能彻底解决！
“猫儿，待会儿爷要拆了你身上的所有关节……”夏侯擎天在玉绯烟耳边缓缓地说着，“你忍着点儿！”
扭断关节，让骨骼重新生长，这是重塑肉体的关键。只有这样才能更好的让太极养生泉发挥最大的疗效，这个道理玉绯烟懂。
“我不怕，你动手吧！”她点了点头。
“爷开始了——”
夏侯擎天下手尽量温柔，可是人身上关节众多，这身子原本就体质孱弱，起初玉绯烟还能忍受，到最后疼痛已经超越人体的承受范围，她完全是靠坚忍不拔的意志支撑着。
等夏侯擎天做完一切，玉绯烟每一根头发丝儿都被汗水浸得湿漉漉的，疼得只剩下一丝微弱的气息。
倔强的猫儿！
小心翼翼地将瘫软的玉绯烟环着怀里，夏侯擎天唇角轻轻地触碰着她的额头。整个过程中玉绯烟始终咬着牙，连哼哼的声音都很轻。即便疼得浑身发抖，她也没有哭出声来。
夏侯擎天非常清楚移骨错筋有多疼，玉绯烟这样隐忍着，愈发像一只柔弱的小猫，让人心里疼惜。

不愧是他看中的人！

content_en:
Regardless of the ambiguous posture of the two of them, Yu Feiyan reached out and hooked Xiahou Qingtian's neck, greedily sucking the sour juice.
"Little wild cat, you are causing the fire -" The fire easily stirred up by Yu Feiyan made Xiahou Qingtian's black eyes dyed purple gold, and the sleeping beast in his heart was awakened, roaring and roaring.
Although he didn't know why he lost control easily when facing Yu Feiyan, Xiahou Qingtian still regained his senses in the shortest time.
Taking a deep breath to calm down the heat in his heart, he put the pulp into Yu Feiyan's mouth again. Only when she regained consciousness did he slowly let go of her lips.
The effect of the Blue Star Fruit was very obvious. The cool liquid made Yu Feiyan feel comfortable all over her body, and her mind gradually cleared up. Only then did she realize that the posture of the two people was very strange.
Xia Hou Qingtian only had a piece of white cloth covering his waist and abdomen. She was held in his arms, with her back pressed against his strong chest. The man's masculinity enveloped her, and Yu Feiyan's cheeks instantly turned red.
Is she being... indirectly eaten?
"Let me go!"
Yu Feiyan pushed Xiahou Qingtian.
Little did she know that the other person's chest was completely impenetrable, but it was as if all the strength in her body had been drained away. She was limp and could only rely on him like a vine.
And her moistened throat has now returned to a soft and soft voice. When these three words came out of her mouth, there was a sense of lingering and coquettishness. Seeing Xiahou Qingtian's teasing eyes, Yu Feiyan quickly covered her lips.
"What a heartless little thing! Who was picking on me just now?"
Xia Hou Qingtian pinched Yu Feiyan's chin, and his eyes invaded her face, which was not sure whether it was because of shyness or because of the spring water.
"You, you took advantage of others' danger..."
Just when Yu Feiyan wanted to use the strength of her elbows to escape from the other person's arms, she found the words "dissatisfied with desire" written on the other person's face, which scared her to the point where she couldn't move.
Brother, show your respect!
She’s still young!
Besides, if you want to eat meat, you can’t choose here. It would be too wild——
"Coward!"
Seeing Yu Feiyan showing weakness, Xiahou Qingtian sneered. His voice was still noble, but the words he spoke were extremely evil. "I'm not interested in bean sprouts. When you grow up, I might give you a chance to devote yourself to it!"
After saying that, Xiahou Qingtian glanced at her evilly, and Yu Feiyan quickly crossed her arms to block her fiery gaze.
Yu Feiyan was completely defeated by the opponent's arrogance.
Who is going to volunteer? Who wants you to give such an opportunity! Arrogant!
Yu Feiyan turned her head, too lazy to pay attention to Xiahou Qingtian, but found a silver-blue spring water next to her, with waves of cold air rising from the water.
He just said this was the Fire Spring, could it be the Ice Spring over there?
Jade Feiyan was a little sluggish for a moment.
According to the "Medicine King Bible", Tai Chi health spring consists of Fiery Spring and Ice Spring. One is cold and one is hot, one is yin and one is yang. The harmony of the two extremes can not only relax the muscles and cleanse the marrow, reshaping a person, but also reshape the body and adjust the human body to its optimal state.
However, Tai Chi Health Spring only lasts for ten days. After that time, it will turn into ordinary spring water. This is why it is extremely precious.
Because it is the most rare opportunity for martial arts practitioners, "The King of Medicine's Bible" hails it as the best spring in the world...
Yu Feiyan originally thought that Tai Chi Health Spring was just a legend, but she didn't expect that she actually saw it with her own eyes. Just now, she had noticed changes in her slender tendons. These were the benefits brought by the Fire Spring.
If the two spring waters are used together, her problem of being unable to practice martial arts due to physical reasons can be completely solved!
"Cat, I'm going to remove all the joints on your body later..." Xiahou Qingtian said slowly in Yu Feiyan's ear, "Please bear with it!"
Breaking joints and allowing bones to regrow is the key to rebuilding your body. Only in this way can the Tai Chi health spring exert its maximum effect., Yu Feiyan understands this truth.
"I'm not afraid, just do it!" She nodded.
"I'm starting--"
Xiahou Qingtian tried his best to be gentle, but there were many joints in the human body, and the body was already weak. At first, Yu Feiyan could bear it, but in the end, the pain exceeded the range of the human body. She relied entirely on her perseverance to support her.
By the time Xiahou Qingtian finished everything, every strand of Yu Feiyan's hair was soaked with sweat, and it was so painful that only a faint breath remained.
Stubborn cat!
Carefully holding the limp Yu Feiyan in his arms, Xiahou Qingtian's lips gently touched her forehead. During the whole process, Yu Feiyan gritted her teeth and even hummed very softly. Even though she was shaking with pain, she didn't cry.
Xiahou Qingtian knew very well how painful it was to move bones and muscles. Yu Feiyan endured it like this, becoming more and more like a weak kitten, which made people feel cherished.
As expected of the person he likes!
